name: Naturalidad de Expresión
description: Analiza la naturalidad de expresiones faciales en video para detectar deepfakes
algorithm: Expression Naturalness — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes facial expression dynamics for deepfake detection:

1. **Action Unit Detección**: Facial Action Coding System (FACS) action units (AUs) are detected per frame — AU1 (inner brow raise), AU2 (outer brow raise), AU4 (brow lowerer), AU6 (cheek raiser), AU12 (lip corner puller), etc. The activation intensity of each AU is continuously measured.

2. **Expression Dynamics Análisis**: Natural facial expressions follow specific temporal dynamics: onset (muscles contracting, ~0.5s), apex (peak expression, variable duration), and offset (muscle relaxation, typically slower than onset). The method verifies that detected expression transitions follow these physiologically constrained dynamics. Deepfakes may produce expressions that appear/disappear too quickly or show unnatural dynamics.

3. **AU Co - Occurrence Validación**: Certain AU combinations are anatomically linked: genuine smiles (Duchenne smiles) involve AU6+AU12 simultaneously, genuine surprise involves AU1+AU2+AU5+AU26. The method checks whether detected AU combinations follow anatomically valid co-occurrence patterns. AI-generated expressions may produce anatomically impossible AU combinations.

4. **Micro - Expression Detección**: Brief involuntary micro-expressions (lasting 40-200ms) reveal suppressed emotions. Their presence and naturalness are analyzed — authentic video may contain micro-expressions consistent with the behavioral context, while deepfakes typically lack these subtle physiological signals.

5. **Expression - Context Coherencia**: Facial expressions should be contextually appropriate — matching speech content, conversational dynamics, and emotional context. The method evaluates expression-speech correlation and emotional trajectory coherence. Deepfakes may produce expressions that are contextually inappropriate or emotionally flat.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante expression naturalness analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
Nirkin, Y. et al. (2019). FSGAN: Subject Agnostic Face Swapping and Reenactment. ICCV.
